title: Zoologists and Wildlife Biologists
description: Study the origins, behavior, diseases, genetics, and life processes of animals and wildlife. May specialize in wildlife research and management. May collect and analyze biological data to determine the environmental effects of present and potential use of land and water habitats.

tasks.text: Inventory or estimate plant and wildlife populations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Measuring environmental characteristics needs instruments

tasks.text: Disseminate information by writing reports and scientific papers or journal articles, and by making presentations and giving talks for schools, clubs, interest groups and park interpretive programs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reports drafted; presentations need human delivery

dwas.name: Prepare scientific or technical reports or presentations.

tasks.text: Develop, or make recommendations on, management systems and plans for wildlife populations and habitat, consulting with stakeholders and the public at large to explore options.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Environmental advice is knowledge-based with review

dwas.name: Advise others about environmental management or conservation.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Study animals in their natural habitats, assessing effects of environment and industry on animals, interpreting findings and recommending alternative operating conditions for industry.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Analysis aided; primary environmental data collection human

dwas.name: Research environmental impact of industrial or development activities.

tasks.text: Study characteristics of animals, such as origin, interrelationships, classification, life histories, diseases, development, genetics, and distribution.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Bioinformatics aided; wet-lab work human

dwas.name: Examine characteristics or behavior of living organisms.

tasks.text: Inform and respond to public regarding wildlife and conservation issues, such as plant identification, hunting ordinances, and nuisance wildlife.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public environmental communication needs trust and accountability

dwas.name: Communicate with the public on environmental issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Organize and conduct experimental studies with live animals in controlled or natural surroundings.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Research planning needs domain expertise and feasibility
information retrieval — AI can search and summarize literature, human curates

dwas.name: Review professional literature to maintain professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Coordinate preventive programs to control the outbreak of wildlife diseases.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Compliance coordination needs human accountability and site action

dwas.name: Coordinate safety or regulatory compliance activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Check for, and ensure compliance with, environmental laws, and notify law enforcement when violations are identified.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Maps facts to statutes; legal accountability stays human

dwas.name: Assess compliance with environmental laws.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Perform administrative duties, such as fundraising, public relations, budgeting, and supervision of zoo staff.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI tracks and models budgets; human owns allocation decisions

tasks.text: Analyze characteristics of animals to identify and classify them.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Examining live organisms needs hands-on lab work

dwas.name: Examine characteristics or behavior of living organisms.

tasks.text: Prepare collections of preserved specimens or microscopic slides for species identification and study of development or disease.

dwas.name: Prepare biological samples for testing or analysis.

tasks.text: Collect and dissect animal specimens and examine specimens under microscope.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Biological sample analysis needs wet-lab execution

emerging_tasks.task: Use advanced technologies, such as GIS, remote sensing, and drone technology, for wildlife tracking, habitat mapping, and population studies.
